# Encyclopedia of Alabama

> > Comprehensive digital encyclopedia documenting Alabama's history, culture, geography, wildlife, and people from Native American heritage through modern times.

The Encyclopedia of Alabama serves as the authoritative online reference for the state's rich heritage, covering topics from Creek War history and Civil Rights movements to endangered species, historic architecture, and economic development. It provides detailed articles on Alabama's counties, notable figures, natural resources, and cultural institutions.

## Key Topics

- Alabama history
- Native American heritage (Choctaw, Creek)
- Civil War and Reconstruction
- Alabama counties (Baldwin, Mobile, Montgomery, DeKalb, Washington, Colbert, St. Clair)
- Endangered species and wildlife conservation
- Historic architecture and preservation
- Coal mining and industrial history
- Birmingham and Montgomery
- Antebellum plantations
- Labor movements and sharecropping
- Forestry and natural resources
- Education reform
- Regional geography (Tennessee Valley, Coastal Alabama)
- Notable Alabamians
- Tourism and cultural landmarks

## History and Heritage

- [Choctaws in Alabama](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/choctaws-in-alabama): History of Choctaw Indians in Alabama including MOWA Band and removal era
- [Coal Mining](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/coal-mining): History of Alabama coal mining industry and economic development
- [Alabama Sharecroppers Union](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/alabama-sharecroppers-union): 1930s Communist Party-affiliated labor union organizing tenant farmers
- [Montgomery, Lemuel P.](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/montgomery-lemuel-p): Creek War soldier killed at Horseshoe Bend, Montgomery County namesake
- [Ruby Pickens Tartt](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/ruby-pickens-tartt): Sumter County folklore collector for Federal Writers' Project

## Historic Sites and Architecture

- [Belle Mont Mansion](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/belle-mont-mansion): 1828 Palladian mansion in Tuscumbia, Colbert County historic landmark
- [St. Clair County Courthouse](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/st-clair-county-courthouse): Historic 19th-century courthouse in Ashville, St. Clair County
- [National Society of Colonial Dames of America in Alabama](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/national-society-of-colonial-dames-of-america-in-alabama): Women's historical preservation organization maintaining Condé-Charlotte House

## Natural Resources and Wildlife

- [Alabama Forestry Commission](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/alabama-forestry-commission): State agency managing forests, timber industry, and fire protection
- [Alabama Streak-Sorus Fern](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/alabama-streak-sorus-fern): Rare endangered fern species endemic to Sipsey Fork, Bankhead Forest
- [Pine Barrens Tree Frog](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/pine-barrens-tree-frog): Endangered tree frog species in longleaf pine habitats of Alabama
- [One-toed Amphiuma](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/one-toed-amphiuma): Endangered salamander species in coastal Alabama and Mobile County
- [Roland Harper](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/roland-harper): Botanist with Geological Survey of Alabama documenting native vegetation

## Notable People and Culture

- [Caitlín R. Kiernan](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/caitlin-r-kiernan): Birmingham dark fantasy author, paleontologist, and comic book writer
- [Flock Family](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/flock-family): Fort Payne racing family pioneering NASCAR and stock car racing history

## Education and Infrastructure

- [Coastal Alabama Community College](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/coastal-alabama-community-college): Multi-campus community college formed from consolidation in south Alabama
- [A+ Education Partnership](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/a-education-partnership): Montgomery-based nonprofit advocating for K-12 education reform in Alabama
- [Weiss Dam and Lake](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/weiss-dam-and-lake): Alabama Power hydroelectric dam and reservoir in Cherokee County

## Optional

- [Unclaimed Baggage Center](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/unclaimed-baggage-center-ubc): Scottsboro retail business selling unclaimed airline luggage since 1970s
- [Kansas](https://encyclopediaofalabama.org/article/kansas): Small town in Walker County with Civil War history and local government
